bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Judy Estroff's research focuses on fetal abnormalities detected by ultrasound. Estroff and colleagues have followed infants after birth to determine which features on echogram signal the need for follow-up by amniocentesis or intervention, and which are associated with normal clinical outcomes.
